H-01.title: Tactical spell presentation, immediate post-command motion, positive spell reaction, self-cast preservation, and distinct category feedback
rootCausesFixed: src/client/main.js act() previously offset new battle command event start times behind unfinished prior-command animations (start + end - motionTime), causing immediate post-cast sampling to observe the previous turn's walk animation instead of the newly committed cast/buff/hit animation. New battle commands now replace battleEvents immediately at motionTime while preserving multi-step sequencing within a single command.

src/client/main.js drawFigure() previously lacked pointer-events: none on figGroup, allowing unit <image> plates to intercept board cell clicks ([data-cell]) and target pad clicks ([data-target]) at adjacent coordinates.

src/client/committed-motion.js committedBattleEvents() and motionFor() now preserve spellId, effectCategory (damage, buff, heal, debuff), selfTarget, and affectedTargets across single-target and AoE spells, iterating backward so the latest active event wins.

src/client/actor.js clipAngles/plateOffset and src/client/anatomy.js paintedPose now support cast, buff, heal, and debuff clips so friendly buffs/heals never trigger rotate(14) hit recoil or rotate(70) death tilt.
src/client/committed-motion.js activeCommittedFeedback() now scopes to the latest committed actionId so prior commands' spell overlays do not linger across subsequent player commands.
H-01.assetLimitationNote: Current runtime troop and creature sprites (assets/runtime-code-20261007/troops/*.png, assets/derivatives/image-vertex-repair-20261009/actors/troops/*.png, assets/derivatives/image-complete-20261011/actors/plates/*.png) are single-pose/plate whole-image PNGs rendered via drawPlate with whole-image translate/rotate transforms rather than multi-part jointed rig anatomy. Full multi-part troop limb articulation remains PARTIAL_ASSET_LIMITATION unless new multi-part troop rig assets are authored.

D-01.title: Tactical spell allowance guidance and explicit disabled-state reasons
rootCausesFixed: src/client/tactical-ui.js intentSentence() updated from 'A stack casts once this round.' to 'Choose one listed cast. Your hero casts once per battle round.' to match battle.castThisRound reset in nextRound.
src/client/tactical-ui.js spellAvailability() and battleSpellAvailability() distinguish available, round-used, insufficient-mana, no-known-spell, and no-target.

src/client/main.js exposes the allowance state visibly in the status bar ([data-spell-allowance]), in the Spellbook panel ([data-spell-guidance]), and on the dock Spell button (data-spell-reason, title, aria-label) without relying on hover.

D-02.title: Zero battle mana visibility in Tactical hero plaque
rootCausesFixed: src/client/tactical-ui.js tacticalHeroPlaqueCopy() and src/client/main.js paintTacticalHeroPlaque() now check Number.isFinite(mana) instead of battle.mana > 0 so 'Mana 0' remains visible and in aria-label when mana is exhausted, with identical 70px plaque height.
